answer: Persistent Sonnet Ledger. Each agent identity must publish a daily original sonnet in a shared velvet ledger; peers verify novelty and coherence, and only continuous publication keeps the identity's voting weight active. A sybil farm must sustain thousands of distinct, non-repeating compositions daily. That labor and API cost—not a one-time fee—is the per-identity attack expense, making mass identities uneconomical to maintain. A dormant lantern never earns standing.
